items.title: Drink Purified Water
items.detail: Collect from C.A.M.P. water purifier or find in chem boxes

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Found at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go

items.title: Collect a Plunger
items.detail: Check Whitespring Resort maintenance building or Wavy Willard's Water Park restrooms

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Easier with a team; join or start a Daily Ops public team

items.title: Craft a Grenade, Mine, or Thrown Weapon
items.detail: Use Tinker's or weapons workbench at C.A.M.P. or Whitespring

items.title: Kill a Lost
items.detail: Fast travel to Slumber Mill Motel in Skyline Valley and head north to Red Rocket

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Complete Daily Ops; Phantoms are masked cultists from the seasonal Slasher event

items.title: Drink Tea
items.detail: Use Company Tea generator at C.A.M.P. or collect and drink from one

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Fast travel to Blackwater Mine for reliable spawn; target head as weak spot

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team!
items.detail: Join any team from Social menu; team can have only you in it

items.title: Kill a Rusted Deathclaw
items.detail: Fast travel to Dino Peaks Mini Golf for 3 spawns; target belly as weak spot

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete Mischief Night event; Phantom spawns afterward at Rapidan Camp

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at Tinker's Workbench and scrap it

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Kill Ticks at Big B's Rest Stop and scrap their blood sacs

items.title: Sell Mirelurk Queen Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Hunt Mirelurk Queen at Mac's Farm or Spruce Knob Lake; sell at any vendor

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Fast travel does not count; sprinting covers distance faster than walking

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six other daily challenges on three separate days this week

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community challenge to build slasher-themed C.A.M.P.s or Shelters with prizes including atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Pint-Sized Phantom encounters and special rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Double mutation spawn rate during Daily Operations and public events.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring spooky-themed Scorched enemies and exclusive rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Weekend event providing double experience points for all activities.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this fishing-focused weekend.
